name: gamenet_set_status_bits_from_flags
description: GameNet::SetStatusBitsFromFlags splits status flag bits 0 and 1 into the allow-maps and name-tags globals.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent GameNet status/session source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x433710 validates masking bit 0 into g_GameNetStatus_AllowMaps and bit 1 into g_GameNetStatus_NameTags.
The native GameNet status smoke verifies setting flags 3 enables both accessors and setting flags 0 clears both globals and accessors.
